  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts used the shipping address. Although it is the current home address, its registration age does not qualify for the household exception. Linkage is the only adverse family; no other rule holds and no earlier outcome settles the order. Household sharing is the strongest benign explanation, but prior installment payments do not establish who is ordering. No checks have run, and the order has not shipped. Recommend needs_check with issuer authentication and identity verification. With only Linkage present, decline and escalation are not currently permitted. This recommendation is advisory and sets no queue priority."
